The '''Legacy''' was a model of [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] produced by [[Praxon]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />
{{Veh-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Praxon Legacy was a player mount in the video game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" /> It was added to the game on [[June 9]], [[2015]] as one of the items in the Mid Rim Explorer's Pack on the Cartel Market.
